impact: A long succession and a wave of downgrades keep a lid on NVDA into its Nov 17 earnings, which weighs on AI-chain sentiment for MU, DRAM, SNXX and NBIS.
summary: At least six analysts downgraded Nvidia between Wednesday night and Thursday morning after Jensen Huang's resignation, and Citi reportedly cut its price target to $225 from $285. CNBC reports a permanent CEO is likely to come from outside the company, and one analyst expects CFO Colette Kress to serve as interim CEO for about a year. Yahoo Finance's live coverage reports allegations of a third affair have emerged. Shares fell as much as 13% to 14% early Thursday before paring losses to about 5%.
title: At least six analysts downgrade Nvidia; Citi cuts target to $225
